displayName: Demo - Require MFA for Azure management (report-only)

emergencyAccessExclusion.description: Object ID of the tenant's emergency-access (break-glass) group. Break-glass accounts must be excluded from this policy so an identity-provider or network outage can never prevent tenant recovery. A future apply workflow must fail closed if this placeholder is still present.

notes: Report-only demo input for a Microsoft Graph conditionalAccessPolicies resource targeting the built-in 'Microsoft Azure Management' service principal (appId 797f4846-ba00-4fd7-ba43-dac1f8f63013), which covers Azure Resource Manager, the Azure portal, Azure CLI, and Azure PowerShell. Not applied to any tenant by this repository. Before controlled deployment: (1) replace the emergency-access placeholder, (2) confirm Entra ID P1 (minimum) or P2 licensing for all in-scope users, (3) consider narrowing 'includeRoles: All users' to only users with any Azure RBAC role once role-assignment scoping is available, (4) review sign-in logs during the report-only period.
